name: AK18C - Pocket CO2 Monitor & Detector (CO2), NDIR Infrared Sensor, 39g
highlights: The Infrared CO₂ Version of the AK18 Body — Where AK18B pairs a semiconductor CO₂ element with TVOC, this configuration puts the whole budget into one channel: infrared NDIR CO₂, with nothing else competing for the screen.

The Reading Travels Without Drifting — A pocket instrument moves between a cold car, a warm office and a humid kitchen in an hour. Infrared measurement is unaffected by all three; a semiconductor element is not.
A Single Number, Nothing Else — One reading with a colour band. For anyone whose job is to walk into a room and answer one question about ventilation.
500 mAh, USB-C — Roughly an hour to charge.
100 Per Carton — The accuracy tier of the AK18 family, shipping in the same box as the entry versions.
